title: The rule of 70: how fast your money loses value #shorts
description:
In 1970, $100 under a mattress would buy only about $12 worth of stuff today. So where did the other $88 go?
Full video on the Coin Theory channel.

Data: US Bureau of Labor Statistics (CPI-U, average prices, average hourly earnings) and Federal Reserve (Fed funds rate), retrieved from FRED, Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis, through September 2026.

This video is for education only and is not financial advice.
Original script, characters and animation. Narrated with an AI voice.
